title: Singapore Couple Escape
headline: Gardens, the bay and a night skyline — four nights for two.
description: A compact Singapore stay: one hotel, Gardens by the Bay, a bay evening and time for a neighbourhood you actually want to walk.
image_alt: Singapore skyline and Merlion at night
price_label: Quoted for your hotel and dates
price_guidance: Singapore pricing depends on hotel area and whether you add Gardens conservatories, a night safari or a Sentosa evening. We confirm a written total before you reserve.
overview: A couple’s long weekend in one walkable city. Mornings for a neighbourhood — Tiong Bahru, Kampong Gelam or Chinatown — evenings for the bay. Parks and tickets only when you want them.
highlights: Four nights in one Singapore hotel.
A Gardens by the Bay evening, tickets as quoted.
Time for a neighbourhood walk and hawker dinner.
Optional Sentosa or night safari if you add it.
why: Short flight from many Indian cities; one hotel, no island-hop.
Vegetarian hawker and restaurant options are easy to plan.
Visa guidance for Indian passports, timed to your tickets.

exclusions: Singapore visa fees if they apply

Personal expenses, GST and tourism fees
